PatientPolicy.answer("slot") returns the entire schedule["works"] list via true_values("slot") instead of picking a single slot when asked which open time the patient wants, and PatientPolicy.respond_offer calls answer("slot") again when refusing an offer, repeating the same full list. Because multiple slots do not clearly support one option (and approximate times make match_slot ambiguous), the driver's reader model returns "unclear" twice and hands the patient off to staff.
